corner_speed.rule: Set by design, as the stop plan's a_stop is: a_brake is a_stop (1.2 m/s^2, below what the weakest cars brake at); a_lat is the lowest grip in any range (0.5 g) times the same margin, 1.2 / 1.7 = 0.7: 0.7 x 0.5 x 9.81 = 3.4 m/s^2. Tuning on training cars (below) cannot choose it: they never need it, and every candidate finished every trip, so the fastest plan won on return.
